# Original OG evidence retained by the host adapter

These files are byte-for-byte copies of existing saved evidence. No live
capture, compiler run, source retrieval or runtime substitution produced them.
`og_retention/binding.rs` pins every raw SHA before parsing and verifies the
runtime hashes, selected literal addresses and report links. Original arithmetic
fixtures remain unchanged in `erc20/balances/tests/fixtures/og-model/`.

The token and helper source-unavailable responses accompany their original
404 reports. They are not verified source. The router report and full runtime
remain separate dependencies. Both OG pools independently recorded the same
runtime hash; `pool-ybc-prestate.json` supplies identical full code from a
differently addressed historical YBC pool. No YBC state is imported.

The `*.rs.txt` files are inert historical diagnostic/publisher evidence; they
must not be executed by this offline workflow. The mismatch report's recorded
source digest differs from the later saved inspector copy. The binding preserves
both identities without claiming an exact as-run source match. Published
failure/runtime/SLOAD links are checked against the original report.

`pool-snapshots.jsonl`, its scan report, the immutable original block manifest
and the unchanged compact `pool-range.json` are independent comparison inputs.
They never supply journal values after initialization. The new finite replay
starts at the first full holder checkpoint, not at the older pool scan boundary.
See [the adapter scope](../../../../docs/og-retained-inputs.md) for limitations.

`journal.jsonl` is the new portable output of the original-PB-bound collector,
not a historical RPC capture. Its exact digest is pinned in `journal.rs`; final
replay must independently regenerate identical bytes. Initialization uses the
unchanged earliest 153-word holder checkpoint plus exactly four raw pool cursor
words from the same independently captured boundary. All 17 overlaps must agree;
a structured provenance manifest binds the 157-word join to both inputs.
